summary: P reproduces byte-identically; only inputs.json differs, in the interpreter path. The v3 fixes are correct. (a) Confirmed: the B/S32 first-pass off-target pattern (r1-r3 -739 +- 159, 4.6 sigma) comes from global detrending and a constant baseline during a ~38 mpix drift. Per-event fits, with or without centroid terms, give flat depths (924/949, 1061/999 ppm). (b) Stronger than stated: T9's 3.77 sigma S98 excess comes entirely from one event, epoch 8, next to a 5.4-h gap containing a momentum dump. Without it the value is +4 +- 71 ppm. On the same 8 clean events T9's method gives -74 and the per-event method +20 +- 49/75. A ~200 ppm excess is disfavoured at ~3.8 sigma by S98+S32; effects below ~100 ppm are untested. (c) Confirmed: S32 is <1.1 sigma under every method (T9-method S32 numbers reproduced exactly). (d) Refuted as a method effect: the ~180 ppm S98 difference is event selection (epoch 8). The paired difference on identical events is -93 +- 63. The error model matters only for the contaminated statistic: white 5.0, null 3.8, event scatter 0.8 sigma. S6 T9-method values (149.5/232) follow from annulus clipping and one dump-adjacent event; S6 is untestable. The PRF confirms that a 43'' source makes the core shallower (r1-r2 -268 to -364 ppm), so 'core deeper' is not an off-target signature. (e) Confirmed: no claim in U's manuscript changes. M C092 is resolved.

facts.quantity: Signal B, S32 2-min TPF: apparent off-target (depth grows with aperture) pattern of the first pass
facts.value: Methodological false positive (confirmed). Per-event quadratic-in-time fits give flat depths with or without centroid terms. Epoch -164: r1 951 raw / 924 +- 209 corrected; r3 895 raw / 949 +- 151 corrected. Epoch -162: r1 1071 / 1061 +- 256; r3 1016 / 999 +- 176 ppm. Combined r1-r3 = +8 +- 120 ppm (white errors). The on-target PRF prediction is r1/r3 = 1.02; a source at TIC 4206077 (43'') predicts r1/r3 = 0.12.
facts.uncertainty: white errors are lower bounds (S98 red-noise factor ~1.6 in verif T5); only 2 events
facts.evidence: addenda/tic4206066_pixel_recheck/out/after_decorrelated.json B.S32_tpf2min.events[*].raw / .corrected ; addenda/tic4206066_FINAL_RECONCILIATION/_work/T8_pixel_recheck/out/t8_b_and_paired.json key B_diff_1.0-3.0_combined_white ; addenda/tic4206066_FINAL_RECONCILIATION/_work/T8_pixel_recheck/out/t8_prf_offtarget_signature.json S32_tpf2min.*.depth_ratio_vs_r2 ; addenda/tic4206066_FINAL_RECONCILIATION/_work/T8_pixel_recheck/out/t8_b_drift.json (epoch -164: core range 3.2% in 30-min bins, y centroid range 38 mpix; -162: 0.8%, 4 mpix)
facts.notes: The first-pass pattern comes from the global 0.75-d running median (s02), and from a constant local-median baseline (s04), neither of which follows the ~38-mpix y drift in epoch -164. Because the time-only (raw) fit also flattens the pattern, the flattening is not an artefact of centroid regressors absorbing a real blend signal (REVIEW_1 C6).
